# aayushict

> Aayush Namdev trades Nasdaq futures (NQ and MNQ) on funded accounts from India. He explains macro events (NFP, CPI, the Fed) in plain words, shows every payout with proof, and links them to real trades. Not a signal service. Not advice.

## Pages

- [Home](https://aayushict.space/): who I am, how I trade, and the gap this site fills.
- [Start here](https://aayushict.space/start-here/): one real NFP night on 7 August 2026 with the numbers and screenshots, why it was rare, and how to trade US futures from India through prop firms.
- [About](https://aayushict.space/about/): who Aayush Namdev is, how he trades (macro for direction, a 1 minute scalping model in the New York morning session), and his payouts so far with certificates.
- [Learn](https://aayushict.space/learn/): guides on prop firms and payouts, with the numbers worked out.
- [Your account is charging you for profit you never took](https://aayushict.space/learn/prop-firms/apex-intraday-trailing-drawdown/): how an intraday trailing drawdown (Apex 50K, $2,000) charges you for profit you never took, and when end of day fits better.
- [Journal](https://aayushict.space/journal/): his own story and the trades he took, in his own words.
- [FOMC Night: One Scalp, Then I Closed the Chart](https://aayushict.space/journal/fomc-night-2026-10-28/): 28 Oct 2026. He waited for the chairman's words, took one scalp on NQ, and closed the chart.
- [How I trade](https://aayushict.space/how-i-trade/): a preview of the model behind about 95% of his trades. His day in order (daily, 1 hour, 5 minute, then the 1 minute entry), the two checks that decide if he trades, one trade a day, 20 to 30 minutes, mostly in the New York morning session. The entry model itself is not published.
- [Disclosure](https://aayushict.space/disclosure/): how the site earns, which links are affiliate links, and which are not.
- [Disclaimer](https://aayushict.space/disclaimer/): not advice, not a signal service, trading is risky.
- [Privacy](https://aayushict.space/privacy/): no cookies, cookieless visit counts through Vercel Analytics, email stored at Buttondown.
